declarations.name: AuiSlider
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Slider: `<aui-slider>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text, referenced by the thumbs.

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Values snap to min + n * step.

inputs.name: largeStep
inputs.description: Page Up/Page Down step (default: a tenth of the scale in whole steps).

inputs.name: marks
inputs.description: true: a tick per step (up to 100); or explicit { value, label? } marks.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Number format of the value text.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name (hidden inputs; a range submits two values).

inputs.name: showValue
inputs.description: Show the value next to the label.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the value text and thumb names.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: The value changes while dragging or with a key: { value }.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The value was committed (pointer release or a key): { value }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear the error.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Slider and Multi-Thumb Slider: each thumb is role=slider with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuetext.

limitations: Always has a value, so it is never 'missing'; use setCustomError (or Form rules) for range rules.
